name: Gaussian Opacity Fields (GOF) Mesh Extraction
aliases: mesh extraction from standard 3-D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method to extract a 3-D triangulated mesh from a trained Gaussian model (3-D Gaussian Splatting) without retraining, by building a volumetric density field and extracting an isosurface.
summary: Gaussian Opacity Fields Mesh Extraction generates 3D meshes from Gaussian Splatting by accumulating opacity-based density into a voxel grid and extracting an isosurface, distinguishing itself from distance-based methods.
